body:
New apps/server/main.c (poll() loop, embedded FIFO queue -- a real correction to NORTHSTAR.md's own original plan, since no reusable matchmaker binary exists for DW2's TCP/tick design), core/protocol.{h,c} wire codec, ported net/http/iduna infra. IDUNA: games.Registry['deadweight_2'], DEADWEIGHT2-SERVER M2M agent, migration 202609250900. Live-verified over the real wire protocol: a real loadout beats an empty grid in 21 ticks, illegal placement/cut rejection, pack-deadline auto-start, forfeit-on-disconnect all confirmed against raw wire bytes, not just the test client. Commits DEADWEIGHT_2@6c1ba0c, IDUNA@cec4405.

⚓ ☃
title: Phase D2: dw2_server, real server-authoritative 1v1 over TCP
